news.title: GSB Finance Limited Announces Regularization of Vivek Kumar Singhal as Managing Director, Effective February 16, 2026
news.body: GSB Finance Limited at its board meeting held on January 16, 2026 announced the regularization of Mr. Vivek Kumar Singhal (DIN: 01962224) (Executive, Non-Independent), as Managing Director of the Company, effective February 16, 2026.Mr. Vivek Kumar Singhal is a Chartered Accountant who has an experience of 18 years in share investment activities in shares and securities including trading in shares derivative and commodity derivatives Date of appointment February 16, 2026 Reason for Change viz. news.title: Gsb Finance Limited Approves Appointment of Vivek Kumar Singhal as Chief Financial Officer, Effective January 16, 2026
news.body: GSB Finance Limited announced at that the meeting of the Board of Directors held on January 16, 2026, approved appointment of Vivek Kumar Singhal as Chief Financial Officer. Mr. Vivek Kumar Singhal Appointment as CFO and Regularization as Managing Director of the Company pursuant to the change in control of the company and the resultant change in management of the Company as approved by the Reserve Bank of India. Appointment as CFO w.e.f. January 16, 2026. Regularization as on February 16, 2026 for a period of 5 years as a Managing Director. Mr. Vivek Kumar Singhal is a Chartered Accountant who has an experience of 18 years in share investment activities in shares and securities including trading in shares derivative and commodity derivatives. news.title: GSB Finance Limited Announces Management Changes, Effective November 20, 2025
news.body: GSB Finance Limited at its meeting of the Board of Directors, held on November 20, 2025, considered and approved the following: Appointment of Mr. Kshitij Agarwal (DIN: 03377355) as a Non-Executive Additional Director to hold office upto the date of ensuing General Meeting of the Company. Appointment of Mr. Vivek Kumar Singhal (DIN: 01962224) as an Executive Additional Director to hold office upto the date of ensuing General Meeting of the Company. Appointment of Ms. Payal Jain (Membership No: A73458) as a Company Secretary and Compliance Officer of the Company. Reason for change: Pursuant to the change in control of the company and the resultant change in management of the Company as approved by the Reserve Bank of India.
